name: Azerai La Residence, Hue
positioning: Riverside hotel in Hue built around a 1930s art deco colonial mansion on the Perfume River
best_for: Travelers who love art deco and colonial architecture
Visitors exploring Hue's citadel who want a riverside base with a pool

facts.text: The hotel sits on a two and a half-hectare site along the Perfume River.
The hotel is on the banks of the Perfume River, just upstream from Hue's citadel.
The colonial mansion at the heart of the hotel was built in the 1930s as part of the residence of the French Resident Superieure.
The mansion's facade, with long horizontal lines and nautical flourishes, is a hallmark of the streamline moderne school of art deco architecture.
Two contemporary wings, built in 2005, echo art deco aesthetics and embrace a tropical garden and a salt-water swimming pool.
The salt-water pool lies on the far side of the garden, parallel to the river, edged by shaded sun loungers.
Rooms in the original villa have a colonial feel, with ceiling fans, mosquito netting and dark-stained wood furnishings.
Deluxe River View rooms open onto a private sun terrace with views of the Perfume River.
The Monument d'Egypte Suite is infused with Egyptian-inspired elements and opens onto a large veranda with tropical garden.
The fitness centre has TechnoGym treadmills, exercise bikes, an elliptical trainer and strength equipment.
The original villa's reception is decorated with framed photos of Old Hue, next to a bar with deep club chairs.

highlights.text: The heart of the hotel is a 1930s colonial mansion, built as part of the French Resident Superieure's residence, in streamline moderne art deco style.
The Resident Suite occupies the entire top floor of the original governor's mansion and opens onto a veranda with a 360 degree view.
The hotel stands on the banks of the Perfume River, just upstream from Hue's citadel.
A salt-water pool runs parallel to the river on the far side of the tropical garden.

considerations.text: The original governor's mansion is a two-story building with a grand staircase and no lift.
Deluxe Colonial rooms in the mansion have a city view rather than a river view.
WhataHotel notes limited nearby nightlife and a humid tropical climate.
